placements.why: The content establishes calibration as an organizational practice — verifying instruments against reference plates and recording the outcomes as decisions. No existing strata category holds this; Calibration is the named category for this work.
placements.title: From assertion to verified calibration practice
placements.frame: What calibration decisions and verifications are being established as settled outcomes?

placements.title: Calibration verified against reference standards holds across the observing band
placements.frame: How is instrument calibration verified against established reference standards, and what scope does the verification claim?
placements.why: src-1 asserts calibration at 88.4 MHz verified against June reference plates holding across the full observing band; src-4 restates the verification basis. Together they evidence a theme of calibration verification against reference standards that future envelopes will continue to feed.

placements.title: Calibration outcomes recorded as key decisions
placements.frame: How are instrument calibration decisions framed and recorded as settled, load-bearing outcomes?
placements.why: src-2 ratifies a 'Key decisions' section, src-3 records the instrument identification, and src-4 records the calibration parameters with verification basis — together performing decision-level recording of calibration outcomes that future envelopes will continue to feed.
